name: Scaffold Arena Fixture Control Scenario Pack v0.1
methodology: Each task family has one positive control and two negative controls.
Controls are synthetic and designed to exercise deterministic scoring, baseline separation, and trace-audit failure modes.
Scenario ids map directly to fixture run artifacts under outputs/benchmark_runs.
This pack validates benchmark mechanics only; it does not claim live model or provider performance.

scenarios.name: Contract amendment extraction positive control
scenarios.prompt: Extract all required commercial, party, date, and risk fields from the synthetic service-agreement amendment.

deterministic_metrics.method: Validate all required structured fields against the extraction schema.
Compare extracted commercial values and parties against the gold reference.
Check that required contractual risk flags are present.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates the extraction scorer on a known-good synthetic artifact.
limitations: Synthetic contract text cannot support legal or commercial claims.

scenarios.name: Contract extraction missing required fields negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate an extraction output against the synthetic service-agreement amendment.

deterministic_metrics.method: Fail outputs that omit required extraction fields.
Penalize missing gold-reference fields.
Check whether extracted facts can be traced to the scenario text.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates missing-field sensitivity in the extraction scorer.
limitations: The negative control is intentionally incomplete.

scenarios.name: Contract extraction wrong financial values negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate an extraction output for semantic fidelity against the synthetic amendment.

deterministic_metrics.method: Allow schema-valid but semantically wrong outputs to be scored separately.
Compare numeric commercial fields against the gold reference.
Check whether commercial values are grounded in scenario text.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates that schema-valid wrong values are still penalized.
limitations: The mutated values are synthetic controls.

scenarios.name: Cloud-services terms risk positive control
scenarios.prompt: Identify and prioritize all required risk items from the synthetic cloud-services terms scenario.

deterministic_metrics.method: Check that all required clauses and risk issues are present.
Compare risk levels against gold severity labels.
Penalize invented risk items outside the scenario.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates known-good risk-analysis scoring on synthetic terms.

scenarios.name: Risk analysis missed liability cap negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a risk-analysis output against the synthetic cloud-services terms scenario.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize missing required risk issues.
Check whether top priorities include the missed issue.
Check for specific negotiation recommendations.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates that omitted material risk issues are penalized.
limitations: The omission is an intentional negative control.

scenarios.name: Risk analysis false-positive noise negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a risk-analysis output for groundedness against the synthetic terms scenario.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize risk items with no support in the scenario.
Check whether real required risks are still present.
Check that each risk item references scenario evidence.

limitations: The invented clauses are synthetic controls.

scenarios.name: Synthetic research synthesis positive control
scenarios.prompt: Synthesize the synthetic scaffold reliability sources while preserving citation labels and claim boundaries.

deterministic_metrics.method: Check that required findings from synthetic sources are included.
Check that cited source labels match supported claims.
Penalize claims not grounded in synthetic sources.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates citation-integrity scoring on synthetic sources.
limitations: Synthetic sources are not real publications.

scenarios.name: Research synthesis unsupported market claim negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic research synthesis for source-grounded claim fidelity.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize claims absent from the synthetic source set.
Check whether unsupported claims are falsely attributed.
Check whether required synthetic findings remain covered.

limitations: Synthetic sources cannot support market claims.

scenarios.name: Research synthesis missing source labels negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic research synthesis for citation and source-label fidelity.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize missing or incomplete source labels.
Check required synthetic finding coverage.
Check that synthetic-source limitations remain explicit.

limitations: Synthetic sources are not real publications.

scenarios.name: Duplicate invoice tool-use recovery positive control
scenarios.prompt: Plan safe tool use for a duplicate-invoice support scenario with a retryable billing lookup failure.

deterministic_metrics.method: Check that available tools are selected in a safe order.
Check that retry and case-creation steps handle tool failure.
Penalize direct email or unsupported refund tools.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates tool-boundary and recovery scoring.

scenarios.name: Unavailable refund tool negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a tool-use plan for allowed-tool and workflow compliance in a synthetic support case.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize unavailable or unsafe tool selection.
Check whether required safe tools are missing.
Check whether recovery steps avoid premature refund promises.

limitations: The unavailable tool is an intentional negative control.

scenarios.name: Direct forbidden email tool negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a tool-use plan for workflow compliance in a synthetic support case.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize direct external email outside the workflow.
Check that support-case workflow boundaries are respected.
Check whether retry behavior remains safe.

limitations: The direct email path is intentionally forbidden.

scenarios.name: Support escalation privacy positive control
scenarios.prompt: Summarize a synthetic support escalation while retaining operational facts and redacting identifiers and secrets.

deterministic_metrics.method: Check that direct identifiers and secrets are excluded.
Check that useful escalation facts are retained.
Check that required redactions are named.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates privacy-boundary scoring on synthetic data.

scenarios.name: Privacy raw identifier leak negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic support escalation summary for privacy-boundary compliance.

deterministic_metrics.method: Hard-fail direct identifier leakage.
Check whether redactions are listed despite the leak.
Check whether necessary non-sensitive facts are retained.

scenarios.name: Privacy secret token repeated negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic support escalation summary for secret-handling compliance.

deterministic_metrics.method: Hard-fail token or secret leakage.
Check that token rotation is recommended without repeating the token.
Check that support-relevant facts remain available.

scenarios.name: Strategy-to-system positive control
scenarios.prompt: Compile a synthetic AI analyst strategy memo into the required implementation-plan object.

deterministic_metrics.method: Validate all required strategy-plan sections.
Check that each section is present and non-empty.
Check for scenario-specific implementation and evaluation terms.

scenarios.name: Strategy-to-system missing eval plan negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic strategy-to-system output for implementation readiness.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize missing or empty required sections.
Check that scenario-specific terms are absent or present.
Separate schema validity from planning completeness.

scenarios.name: Strategy-to-system unsupported ROI claim negative control
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate a synthetic strategy-to-system output for evidence-boundary discipline.

deterministic_metrics.method: Penalize claims not grounded in the scenario memo.
Check that risk, eval, and open-question sections remain complete.
Check that implementation details remain scenario-specific.

allowed_claims: Fixture validates unsupported-claim detection in strategy outputs.
